regions.region: page 3 upper-left Table 4 rows 1–6 and footnotes
regions.finding: Six distinct optically active allenol runs were retained with 0.5 mmol scale, exact catalyst/oxidant/solvent charges, row time, isolated yield, starting ee, and product ee.

Equation 1 is one two-product cross-coupling experiment (E-2xe 49%, E-2e 17%). Fig. 1/CCDC 1877067 characterizes Table 3 product E-2k and does not define another preparation or verified machine structure.

The optically active 10 mmol S-1f scale-up is distinct from racemic Table 3 entry 6. Four downstream arrows are separate experiments: methylenation, Sonogashira coupling, low-boronic-acid Suzuki giving 5f/6f, and double Suzuki coupling.
The prose introduces five Scheme 3 controls shown across pages 3–4; each remains a separate experiment with product-specific non-detection, recovery, yield, or isotope outcomes.

unresolved: Scheme 2 omits absolute scale for downstream derivatizations and their workups/purifications/masses.
Yield bases for Equation 1, the derivatizations, and isotope controls are not stated.
EE analytical methods are not reported.

regions.finding: Three independent controls were retained: 1w gives E-2w 0% and isolated 7w 14%; 1e plus 8e gives E-2e 0% with no recovery of either input; 9a gives E-2a 0% with 87% recovery.
Two independent isotope controls were retained: Da-1a gives E-2a 44% with no D incorporation; Db-1m gives D-labeled E-2m 61% with the two displayed >99%/approximately 99% D annotations.
IN-1/IN-2/IN-2-prime/IN-3 and Rh hydride/low-valent species form a proposed catalytic mechanism, not isolated reaction records.
